FR-001.title: Expose only task-level controls; backend translates to model-specific parameters

FR-002.title: Never expose runtime/model internals in any user-facing surface or payload

FR-003.title: Advanced panel exposes exactly quality/steps, prompt adherence, reference resolution with safe defaults

FR-004.title: Every generation task supports seed control; lock a seed for exact regeneration

FR-005.title: Modify prompt describes only the change and instructs preservation of all unspecified attributes

FR-006.title: Instant Render prompt structures scene into subject/environment/composition/camera/lighting/treatment

FR-007.title: Form Variate implemented as controlled edits (direction + magnitude + identity constraints)

FR-008.title: Color Variate MVP: palette + colorway count; only specified palette colors may appear

FR-009.title: New View prompt names target viewpoint and imposes geometry/component-preservation constraints

FR-010.title: Animate prompt describes only temporal change; negatives suppress deformation/flicker/duplication

FR-012.title: Modify defaults to strong source preservation; fidelity maps monotonically to edit strength

FR-014.title: Variation batches produce exactly the requested count with unique seeds per output

FR-015.title: Form magnitude maps to bounded edit-strength range; presets map to documented phrasings

FR-016.title: New View requires explicit view selection and at least one connected reference

FR-017.title: Animate accepts start frame (required), end frame (optional), duration mapped to frames/fps by backend

FR-018.title: Extract produces structured records (color/material/parts) with hierarchy or region sampling, background excluded

FR-019.title: Every task surfaces a machine-readable task record for reproducibility and audit

FR-020.title: Backend routes tasks to model classes by capability (t2i, edit, i2v, vision/segmentation)

FR-022.title: One active generation task per user; FIFO queue position visible; queued cancellable, running cancel where supported

FR-023.title: Completed extraction results displayed in node and saved as reusable project assets

tasks.summary: 26 tasks across 9 phases: Foundational (types, resolver, prompt registry, Drizzle tables, coordinator, target extension, facade) then one phase per user story (Modify, Instant Render, Variate, New View, Animate, Extract) and Polish; waves mark independent parallel work.
